method.memory: Sum of RSS of server and all descendant processes; shared pages may be counted twice. Browser/client excluded.
method.cpu: ps cumulative CPU delta across process tree during load, excluding load generator
method.build: Remove framework output before each build; OS disk cache not cleared; excludes toolchain/dependency installation.
